Definition
[exterior derivative via Lie derivatives]

Source: petersen:page-0066 ↗ def:pet-ch2-lie-derivative-tensor

For a $k$-form $\omega $, \[ d\omega (X_0,\dots ,X_k) =\frac12\sum _{i=0}^k(-1)^i(L_{X_i}\omega )(X_0,\dots ,\hat X_i,\dots ,X_k) +\frac12\sum _{i=0}^k(-1)^iL_{X_i}\big(\omega (X_0,\dots ,\hat X_i,\dots ,X_k)\big). \] For a $1$-form this specializes to $d\omega (X,Y)=D_X(\omega (Y))-D_Y(\omega (X))-\omega ([X,Y])$.
